security.title: Security
security.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.

details.title: Your details
details.caption: The name colleagues see beside your replies, and the language this app is in.
details.emailHint: An administrator changes the address an account signs in with.

password.title: Password
password.caption: Changing it signs out every other browser you are signed in on.
password.wrong: That current password is not right.
password.done: Your password was changed. Every other browser was signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.onCaption: Your authenticator app is asked for a code every time you sign in on a new browser.
twoFactor.offCaption: Anyone with your password can sign in as you. Turning this on takes a minute.
twoFactor.requiredCaption: This install requires two-factor authentication, so it cannot be turned off.
twoFactor.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.disableBody: Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm. Afterwards your password alone signs you in.
twoFactor.disabled: Two-factor is off for this account.
twoFactor.regenerateBody: Enter a code from your authenticator app. The codes you have now stop working at once.
twoFactor.regenerated: New recovery codes. The old ones no longer work.
twoFactor.newCodesBody: Each works once, and this is the only time they are shown.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.caption: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, device PIN or a security key, with nothing to type. A passkey also counts as your second factor.
passkeys.footer: Adding, renaming or removing one asks you to confirm it's you. We email you when one is added or removed.
passkeys.emptyBody: Add one to sign in faster and to keep phishing pages out of your account.
passkeys.lastFactor: You can't remove your only second factor: Admins must have one. Add another passkey or turn on an authenticator app first.
passkeys.paused: Passkeys are paused because this install moved to a new address. You can still remove passkeys; adding works again when the address returns.
passkeys.stepUpAdd: Use your passkey, or enter your password or a code from your authenticator app, to add a passkey.
passkeys.stepUpRename: Use your passkey, or enter your password or a code from your authenticator app, to rename “{{name}}”.
passkeys.stepUpRemove: Use your passkey, or enter your password or a code from your authenticator app, to remove “{{name}}”.
passkeys.proofRequired: Enter your password or a 6-digit code.
passkeys.proofWrong: That password or code did not match.
passkeys.passkeyProofFailed: Your passkey couldn't confirm it's you. Try again, or use your password.
passkeys.locked: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
passkeys.waitingBody: Follow your browser's prompt to create the passkey…
passkeys.waitingHint: If you use a password manager, it may offer to save the passkey there instead. Either works.
passkeys.removeBody: You won't be able to sign in or confirm it's you with this passkey any more. Remove it from the key itself too if you no longer need it there.
passkeys.remainingBoth_one: You still have {{count}} passkey and an authenticator app.
passkeys.remainingBoth_other: You still have {{count}} passkeys and an authenticator app.
passkeys.remainingApp: You still have an authenticator app.
passkeys.limitBody: That's the most one account can hold. Remove one you no longer use, then add the new one.
passkeys.cancelled: Adding the passkey was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
passkeys.duplicate: This authenticator is already a passkey on your account.
passkeys.expired: That took too long. Start again.
passkeys.failed: Couldn't add the passkey. Nothing was changed.
passkeys.removeBlocked: This account must keep a second factor. Add another passkey or an authenticator app first.
passkeys.nameBody: Pick a name you'll recognise, like the device it's on.

signInProviders.title: Sign-in methods
signInProviders.caption: Sign in with an account you already use. Each one stays linked to this account until you disconnect it.
signInProviders.notice: Since 1.0.1, a provider signs you in only after you connect it here once. Your password, magic link and two-factor work as before.
signInProviders.neverUsed: not used to sign in yet
signInProviders.notConnected: Not connected. Connect it to sign in with {{provider}}.
signInProviders.lastWayIn: {{provider}} is your only way to sign in. Set a password or connect another provider before you disconnect it.
signInProviders.footer: Connecting or disconnecting asks you to confirm it's you, and we email you about the change. Only providers your administrator turned on are listed.
signInProviders.stepUpConnect: Enter your password or a code from your authenticator app to connect {{provider}}.
signInProviders.stepUpDisconnect: Enter your password or a code from your authenticator app to disconnect {{provider}}.
signInProviders.proofRequired: Enter your password or a 6-digit code.
signInProviders.proofWrong: That password or code did not match.
signInProviders.connectedToast: {{provider}} is connected. You can sign in with it now.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.caption: Every browser this account is signed in on. Signing one out ends it immediately.
sessions.listLabel: Browsers this account is signed in on
sessions.empty: No other browser is signed in.

signature.heading: Email signature
signature.caption: Added under your public replies by email. Never on internal notes, chat or Telegram.
signature.enHint: Plain text, up to 6 lines. Links are made clickable.
signature.arHint: Used when the customer's language is Arabic. Left empty, the English one is used.
signature.tooManyLines: A signature can have at most 6 lines.
signature.actionFailed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
signature.previewCaption: The end of a reply as the customer sees it. Updates as you type.

notifications.heading: What you are told about, and where
notifications.caption: Only about tickets you can see. Emails go to {{email}} in {{language}}, your app language.

assigned.label: Assigned to me
assigned.hint: By a person, a rule or round-robin

replied.label: Reply on my tickets
replied.hint: The contact answers on a ticket assigned to you

mentioned.label: Mentioned in a note
mentioned.hint: Someone writes @{{name}} in an internal note

sla_warning.label: SLA warning
sla_warning.hint: A ticket of yours reaches a warning step before its target

sla_breached.label: SLA breach
sla_breached.hint: A ticket of yours misses its first-response or resolution target

escalated.label: Escalation
escalated.hint: An SLA step or a rule escalates a ticket to you or your team

snooze_ended.label: Snooze ended
snooze_ended.hint: A ticket you snoozed wakes by time or because an SLA is close to its target

notifications.footer: Browser push reaches every browser where you turned it on.
notifications.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
notifications.loadFailed: Your notification settings could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
notifications.note: An SLA breach or escalation sent to a team reaches each member by their own settings. Deactivated staff get nothing. One event sends one email and one push per browser, never more.

push.heading: Browser push on this browser
push.askOnce: Your browser asks for permission once. Push works while this browser is running, even with Helpdock closed.
push.testSent: A test notification is on its way to this browser.
push.turnedOn: Browser push is on for this browser.
push.turnedOff: Browser push is off for this browser.
push.failed: Browser push could not be turned on. Try again in a moment.
push.blockedBody: Helpdock cannot ask again. Allow notifications for {{host}} in the browser's site settings, then reload.
push.unsupportedBody: This browser cannot receive push notifications. In-app and email still reach you.
push.notSetUpHeading: Not set up on this install
push.notSetUpBody: Browser push needs VAPID keys. An install admin adds them to the install's configuration. Until then the push column is disabled.
